boundary: All three failures occurred before heldout access; all affected scientific scores were discarded and recomputed after repair.

failures.failure: Python 3.9 dataclass annotation resolution failed because the dynamically imported R2 module was not registered in sys.modules before exec_module
failures.repair: register spec.name in sys.modules before executing the exact same content-addressed R2 source

failures.failure: parser required line length >=99 although valid summary rows can end at byte 98 after Mmb; member samples were undercounted
failures.repair: accept lines of length >=98; preserve the fixed-width Mmb bytes 94-98 and existing velocity fallback rule

failures.failure: adapter f=0 path used a numerically integrated NFW mass while the fitted baseline used the analytic NFW cumulative mass; exact floor differed by 3.7e-5 to 5.6e-5 km/s and all candidate policies failed the f=0 gate
failures.repair: use the exact analytic NFW cumulative mass as the base mass inside the adapter path; retain numerical convolution only for the convolved branch
